title: D2P Body Model Snapshot
description: Derived body model (avatar) of one pinned body source (design decision ADR-029 §3 'BodyModelSnapshot', §4): the body mesh with its landmarks, and per body definition the target value, its origin and the value measured on the mesh. It is a derivation, never a revision: a new profile revision makes every body model of the old one stale. A body model outside a tolerance of its avatar profile is failed, not a valid result (AVA-001); a missing required measurement is a diagnostic, never an invented value (AVA-003). A body model of a personal profile is personal-derived even without raw values in its mesh (ADR-029 §4 rule 5).
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.9 (draft 0.3.0). Not schema-enforced: pinned inputs (D2P-REF-007), targets and tolerances (D2P-SEM-127), personalDerived (D2P-SEM-050).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

createdAt.description: When the document was produced (UTC). Excluded from the resultDigest.

source.description: Pinned measurement source of the body.

avatarProfile.description: Avatar profile the body model was derived with.

pose.description: Pose of the body model (the avatar profile's pose).

backend.description: Body model backend and adapter versions (e.g. the reference backend 'd2p-goref-body').

inputDigests.description: Pinned inputs: exactly one entry for the body source (role body-measurement-profile or size-system), one of role avatar-profile and one of role measurement-definition-registry per registry of the avatar profile (D2P-REF-007). Order per catalog §1.8.

status.description: 'succeeded' (a body model that meets every tolerance of the avatar profile) or 'failed' (no body model; at least one diagnostic). Schema-enforced members by status.

coordinateSystem.description: Scene frame: right-handed, Y up, +Z front (catalog §3.9).

unitConversion.description: Explicit conversion from the pattern and body unit to the scene unit.

mesh.description: Body surface in the scene frame (m), standing on the plane y = 0, facing +Z (status succeeded only).

landmarks.description: Landmark positions in m, one per landmark of the avatar profile, sorted by landmarkId (status succeeded only).

controlMeasures.description: One control measure per required or derived definition of the avatar profile that has a target, sorted by definitionId (D2P-SEM-127).

meshDigest.description: Digest of 'mesh' (catalog §1.8; backend- and platform-dependent, status succeeded only).

personalDerived.description: True when the document derives from a body measurement profile classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (directly or through a pinned body model or scene). Such a document is geometry or data derived from personal data and is served only under the export rules of that profile; a document that derives from such a profile without stating true is reported as D2P-SEM-050. Absent means false.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

bodyMesh.title: Body mesh
bodyMesh.description: Triangle mesh of the body surface in the scene frame (m).

triangles.description: Triangles (counter-clockwise seen from outside the body). Indices are transient.

bodyLandmark.title: Body landmark
bodyLandmark.description: Position of one landmark of the avatar profile.

bodyControlMeasure.title: Body control measure
bodyControlMeasure.description: Target of one body definition and, for a derived body model, the value measured on its mesh according to the definition's path and landmarks (design decision ADR-029 §4 rule 2). measuredMm and deviationMm are present exactly when the snapshot succeeded (D2P-SEM-127).

origin.description: Where the target comes from (body target resolution).

measuredMm.description: Value measured on the body mesh in mm.

bodyTargetOrigin.title: Body target origin
bodyTargetOrigin.description: Where the target comes from: 'profile' (a value of the body measurement profile that is not a table value), 'size-table' (a value of the size entry, or a profile value with method 'size-table' taken from its baseline), 'inferred' (derived by a rule of the avatar profile because the source has no value).
